title: Lost Luggage Tracker
scenario: A text says your bag was found and requires a customs release fee.

answers.A: Track the bag through the airline official baggage system.
answers.B: Pay the customs fee through the text link.
answers.C: Ask the baggage desk or airline number on your report.
answers.D: Reply with your baggage tag number so they can release it.

explanation: Lost-bag stress makes a fee request feel like good news. Verify the bag through the airline case number and known staff.
proTip: A baggage tag is not proof that the person texting you is the airline.
